motivation: The regression-conditioned higher-order null evaluates the observed first-order recruitment and spread coefficients against simulated coefficient clouds. Because extra-stop spread itself is unusually large, this validation avoids any regression extrapolation by conditioning exactly, within each pair and direction, on the realized number of route-new taxa and their realized total number of occupied sites.
question: After exactly conditioning on recruited-taxon number and total route-new incidence in each direction, is within-taxon concentration of multi-site activity greater on the survey closer to rain than on its paired drier survey?
directional_unit: For every matched pair, compute the endpoint twice: wet survey as target versus dry reference, and dry survey as target versus wet reference.
target_taxa: Taxa absent from the entire reference route and present at >=1 target stop.

statistics.K: Total target incidences summed across those N taxa.
statistics.H: sum_i choose(k_i - 1, 2), where k_i is occupied target stops for target-new taxon i.
statistics.exact_exchangeable_expectation: Expected H across all N x 10 binary target matrices having every row occupied at least once and exactly K total incidences; configurations are weighted by their exact combinatorial multiplicity. Computed by dynamic programming, not simulation.
statistics.raw_excess: H minus the exact conditional expectation.
statistics.z_excess: raw_excess divided by the exact conditional SD when nonzero; otherwise 0.

directional_test.pair_control: Demean endpoint and target_rain_advantage within matched pair; fit OLS without intercept with route-clustered covariance. This is equivalent to a within-pair directional contrast and removes all pair-level covariates exactly.

joint_robustness.sample: Intersection of same-observer pairs and pairs retaining identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
joint_robustness.strong_support_rule: Primary raw-excess and z-excess both have complete 95% CI >0 in the full sample, and raw-excess has complete 95% CI >0 in the joint robustness subset.

interpretation: A positive result establishes rain-selective within-taxon concentration relative to an exact first-order exchangeability null without extrapolating from simulated first-order coefficient clouds.
It does not make taxa exchangeable biologically; cross-fitted species-response and prior-site-history falsifications are separate tests.
It does not establish literal simultaneity, movement, hydrological connectivity, social facilitation, or causal rainfall.
No endpoint, exact-conditioning rule, direction, tail, or support threshold may change after endpoint readback.
